summary: Crank arm kicking' derailer dropping gears shifting in frozen time as fork bends left seeking speed for new paths while pedals just spin around, around again #poemsofpresence #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Crank arm kicking'
derailer dropping
gears shifting
in frozen time
as fork bends
left
seeking speed
for new paths
while pedals
just spin
around, around
again
#poemsofpresence
#smallpoems
